frontmatter_snapshot.summary: EKM's heavy-tail-probability / ruin-asymptotics mechanism for fat tails: when the integrated-tail F_I is subexponential the ruin probability decays polynomially as ψ(u) ~ ρ⁻¹ F̄_I(u), an estimate that holds if and only if F_I ∈ S, contrasting the exponential small-claim Lundberg bound, per Embrechts, Klüppelberg & Mikosch (1997) Ch.1.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Cramér-Lundberg Ruin Theory for Heavy-Tailed (Subexponential) Claims
